originalTitle: Assailant lunged at Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, campaign says
summary: Armed suspect Patrick Havas allegedly attacked Amy Acton during a campaign stop at a fair, injuring several people
content: Amy Acton, Democratic candidate for Ohio governor, was the target of an attack on Sunday during a campaign stop at the Canfield Fair, campaign officials said. Several people were injured when the armed assailant lunged at Acton. The suspect knocked volunteers to the ground before he was arrested and was “discovered to have weapons”, Mahoning county Democratic party chairperson Chris Anderson said in a statement. Sheriff Jerry Greene told a local NBC outlet, 21 News, that the suspect, Patrick Havas, knocked down two older ‌adults during the incident. Havas is expected to be charged with assault and disorderly conduct, Greene told 21 News. Acton was not injured, but campaign officials said multiple people were hurt. She is “grateful for the swift and decisive action of law enforcement and are praying for the recovery of those injured. This kind of violence has no place in Ohio. Dr Acton will always stand up to the chaos, hate and vitriol that pits us against one another,” said Addie Bullock, communications director for the campaign. A photo shared to social media by a fair attendee after the incident showed Acton checking on one of those injured in the incident. “What happened at our tent today during today’s visit from Dr Acton is reprehensible and should be condemned by leaders on all sides of the aisle,” Anderson said. Acton is facing Republican Vivek Ramaswamy, who has parlayed his national name recognition, tech industry connections and alliance with Donald Trump into a record fundraising haul that he is tapping for advertising spots aimed at the November election. He is using campaign rallies and advertising to criticize Acton, the state’s former public health director. Ramaswamy called the incident Sunday unacceptable. “Candidates should be able to meet with voters without having to worry about threats or violence. What happened today is completely unacceptable and has no place in politics, and we hope that no one was hurt,” Ramaswamy’s communications director, Connie Luck, said in a statement on Sunday. Abdul El-Sayad, Michigan’s Democratic US Senate candidate, also denounced the attack. “There’s no place for political violence in America,” El-Sayad said in a social media post. “Our prayers go out to Dr. Acton and her team, and we hope that this moment is yet another wake up call regarding how important it is to make sure that democracy is a process by which we address our political differences peacefully.” The fairground’s police department referred inquiries to the Mahoning county sheriff’s department, which didn’t immediately return a message seeking comment. The Ohio state highway patrol didn’t immediately respond to a request for information.
chineseTitle: 竞选团队称，袭击者袭击了俄亥俄州州长民主党候选人
chineseSummary: 武装嫌疑人帕特里克·哈瓦斯据称在一次集市的竞选活动中袭击了艾米·阿克顿，造成多人受伤
chineseContent: 竞选官员称，俄亥俄州州长民主党候选人艾米·阿克顿(Amy Acton)周日在坎菲尔德博览会(Canfield Fair)的一次竞选活动中遭到袭击。武装袭击者冲向阿克顿时造成多人受伤。马洪宁县民主党主席克里斯·安德森在一份声明中表示，嫌疑人在被捕前将志愿者击倒在地，并“被发现携带武器”。警长杰里·格林 (Jerry Greene) 告诉当地 NBC 媒体 21 News，犯罪嫌疑人帕特里克·哈瓦斯 (Patrick Havas) 在事件中撞倒了两名老年人。格林告诉 21 News，哈瓦斯预计将被指控袭击和扰乱治安行为。阿克顿没有受伤，但竞选官员表示多人受伤。她“感谢执法部门迅速而果断的行动，并为受伤者的康复祈祷。俄亥俄州不允许这种暴力行为。阿克顿博士将永远勇敢地面对使我们相互对立的混乱、仇恨和尖酸刻薄，”该活动的通讯总监艾迪·布洛克(Addie Bullock)说。事件发生后，一名展会参加者在社交媒体上分享了一张照片，照片显示阿克顿正在检查其中一名受伤者。安德森说：“阿克顿博士今天访问期间，今天在我们帐篷里发生的事情应该受到谴责，应该受到两党领导人的谴责。”阿克顿面对的是共和党人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米(Vivek Ramaswamy)，后者利用自己的全国知名度、科技行业人脉以及与唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)的联盟，筹集了创纪录的筹款额，并利用这些资金为11月大选做广告。他利用竞选集会和广告来批评该州前公共卫生主任阿克顿。拉马斯瓦米称周日发生的这一事件是不可接受的。 “候选人应该能够与选民会面
